newsitem.title: USA: NUKO restates Q1 results, loss widens.
newsitem.headline: NUKO restates Q1 results, loss widens.

text.p: NUKO Information Systems Inc said Wednesday it had restated its net loss for the first quarter to $3.9 million, or $0.37 per share, from $1.8 million, or $0.17 per share.
The company lost $0.37 per share in the 1996 first quarter.

Nuko said it was restating results to reflect the non-recognition of certain revenues and the recording of certain reserves. Restated revenues for the first quarter were $2.2 million, compared with the $6.1 million originally announced on April 24.

The restated revenues reflect a deferred revenue recognition of $2.2 million related to new purchase orders from first-time customers, certain uncompleted customer testing, and product support obligations, the company said.
It also said it chose not to recognize revenue of $1.8 million due to issues related to on-time payment.
Included in the restated revenues are reserves of $165,000 taken for foreign taxes related to a one-time licensing fee, the company said.
